item.description:
NVIDIA researchers have released SoL-Pi, 4 harness mechanisms for the open-source Pi coding agent, discovered by an AI running auto-research loops across 535 environments. On EdgeBench, SoL-Pi cuts token traffic by 44.7% to 49.0% and API cost by roughly 33%, while keeping about 94% of Pi's score on GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5.
